items.name: Aix-en-Provence Open 2017

venue.name: Résidence Le California
venue.details: En face de l'hôtel Campanile, après la cour arborée, la salle se trouve au rez-de-chaussée, en face du hall.

items.information: **Aix-en-Provence Open 2017** est une compétition ouverte à tous. L’enregistrement doit être effectué en ligne via le site de la WCA, à partir du vendredi 12 mai. Le nombre maximum de compétiteurs est limité à 35. Une fois cette limite atteinte, il ne sera alors plus possible de s’inscrire, et une liste d'attente sera alors établie.

items.name: EZ Cubes Spring 2017

venue.name: University of Mary Washington, University Center, Chandler Ballroom

items.information: The registration fee is $20. There is a 100 person competitor limit with no at-the-door registration. Also t-shirts are available for $20 (see Shirts). To register, please follow all Instructions on the registration payment tab. Inproper completion of these steps may result in a delay of Registration. If you do not see your name on the compeitors tab after 48 hours of registering, please contact me to resolve the issue. The event list consists of: Rubik's Cube, 2x2, 4x4, 5x5, 6x6, 7x7, Clock, and a Mystery Event for 3x3 finalists.

items.information: ***First time participants*** Step 1 - Sign-up Step 2 - Register for the competition Step 3 - Pay using the link on Cubelelo website ***Other participants*** Step 1 - Sign-in using your email that you used for your previous competitions Step 2 - Register for the competition (ensure your WCA id is mentioned) Step 3 - Pay using the link on Cubelelo website Registrations will be confirmed within 48 hours of making the payment according to the above guidelines. *Last date for registration & payment* - May 25, 2017 Please email us if you want to be a full-time volunteer to receive additional perks. Leave a WhatsApp message on +91 9052529279 if you have additional queries.
